# Noun / Pronoun + 嘅 + Noun · *Noun / Pronoun + ge3 + Noun*

**Meaning:** 's / of (possession and description) · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Possession and description

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fge3-possessive).

嘅 joins an owner or a description to a noun: 我嘅書 (my book), 好食嘅餐廳 (a good restaurant). With family and close friends it is usually dropped: 我媽媽, 我朋友.

**Written Chinese:** 的 — Written Chinese uses 的; in speech say 嘅.

## Examples

|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢本係我嘅書。** |
| Jyutping | ni1 bun2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 syu1. |
| Yale | nī bún haih ngóh ge syū. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄅㄨㄣ² ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄍㄝ³ ㄙㄩ¹. |

## Common mistakes

- Not ~~這是我的書。~~ but **呢本係我嘅書。** *ni1 bun2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 syu1.* · *nī bún haih ngóh ge syū.*  
  這 and 的 are written forms. Speech uses 呢 + classifier and 嘅.
